prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Navigation copy changes on home intro and list layout redesigns for friend selection were helpful, achieving statistically significant wins.
Reordering sign-in to after friend selection, split-screen companion persona selectors, and background desktop alerts significantly worsened performance.
Hints, wait time indicators, new screens, new activity flows, redesign layouts, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for sign-in reordering, split-screen persona selectors, desktop alerts, and early guide screens.
Predictions were too low for navigation copy improvements and list layout redesigns, which resulted in strong wins despite neutral or negative initial predictions.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Compact Account Sync Layout on Sign-In: Redesign the sign-in screen using a compact layout with an active sync status badge to reassure returning users about pet data preservation. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and sign_in has a 27.1% drop-off.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Launch Guide Screen Insertion: Insert a dedicated desktop launch guide screen right before the final home intro screen to explain system tray controls. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding (3 emails) on how to control or hide pets, and finish step conversion is 70.4%.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Centered Animated Intro Layout for Story: Redesign the story introduction screen with a centered layout and an explicit animation asset previewing pet choices. (why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users right at the beginning of onboarding.)
3: [home, hint] System Tray Visibility Hint on Waiting Screen: Display a hint on the waiting screen explaining how desktop background permissions enable pet visibility. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open during first view.)
4: [finish, copy] Right-Click Control Copy on Home Intro: Update the home intro headline and body to explicitly mention right-clicking the system tray icon to control pets. (why: Addressing support queries about how to hide, control, or chat with pets post-setup.)
5: [adoption, copy] Instant Companion Guidance Copy on Pick Friend: Update headline and body on the pick friend screen to clarify immediate availability and customization. (why: Reduces adoption hesitation where 34.4% of users exit the funnel.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Differentiation Copy on Choose Path: Clarify the difference between custom pet creation and quick pet picking on the choose path screen. (why: 3 support tickets cited custom pet creation issues; clear path expectations reduce early bounce (23.8%).)
7: [home, wait_info] Generation Time & Progress Bar on Waiting Screen: Enable time estimates and explicit progress indicators on the waiting screen while desktop animations process. (why: Median waiting time is 201s (mean 2336s) with an 18.7% drop-off rate.)

scores.note: Sign-in redesigns and screen overhauls consistently worsened funnel conversion despite strong support evidence.
Adding new guide screens prior to home negatively impacts completion rate (-9.1% historical).
Layout redesigns and animated intros yield neutral to negative performance without support evidence.
Hints on waiting screens show no clear historical uplift despite targeting known user confusion.
Finish copy updates addressing post-setup control show proven strong historical wins (+12.3%).
Targets the largest drop-off step (34.4%) via simple copy adjustments, aligning with successful copy lessons.
Copy clarification backed by both support tickets and early funnel drop-off carries low implementation risk.
Wait time indicators on home show mild positive historical trend (+1.0%) but generally muted effect.
